card.activation.confirmReplaceCheck: I confirm activating v{versionNo}, replacing the currently active v{activeVersionNo}
card.activation.confirmRollbackCheck: I confirm rolling back to v{versionNo}; new transactions will then be identified with v{versionNo}
card.activation.conflict: The active version was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
card.activation.conflictSeen: The active version this page saw is {version}.
card.activation.impact.activateConflict: If someone else switched the active version after this page opened, the submission is rejected and you're asked to refresh.
card.activation.impact.activateExisting: Payment instruments already created keep their original card attributes and are not affected.
card.activation.impact.activateImmediate: After submission all instances look up against v{versionNo} immediately, without a restart.
card.activation.impact.rollbackNewOnly: Rolling back only affects payment instruments created afterwards; existing transactions keep their original card attributes.
card.activation.impact.rollbackRecorded: The rollback is recorded in the activation history (operator and time).
card.activation.impact.rollbackRetires: v{versionNo} becomes retired and can be activated again later.
card.binInput.tooLong: At most 8 digits; lookups use the BIN only, never a full card number
card.command.notFound: The target doesn't exist. Refresh and try again.
card.csv.nul: The file contains NUL characters and isn't a text CSV
card.csv.tooLarge: The file exceeds the 50 MB limit
card.detail.activateAfterValidation: Can be activated after validation passes
card.detail.activeNote: Rolling back only affects payment instruments created afterwards; card attributes frozen on transactions don't change.
card.detail.title: Version v{versionNo}
card.detail.validatingNote: Refreshes every 3 seconds; it can't be activated before validation finishes. Failures midway are retried automatically, no re-upload needed.
card.history.title: Activation History
card.import.note.direct: The file is uploaded directly to object storage without passing through the Gateway; once uploaded, a version is created automatically and fully validated in the background. Closing the dialog aborts the upload.
card.import.note.format: Platform standard CSV: UTF-8 · comma-separated · line 1 is the fixed header · file ≤ 50 MB and ≤ 1,000,000 rows · bin_prefix is 6–8 digits and must not repeat · card_brand and issuer_country are required · issuer region is derived from the platform country-region mapping.
card.import.precheckPassed: Local pre-check: header correct, first {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} well-formed (full validation runs after the version is created).
card.import.scanBlocked: The file didn't pass the security scan. Check the file and select it again.
card.import.title: Import New Version
card.invalid.hint: Fix the source file and import a new version. The failed version is kept for traceability.
card.invalid.note: Only the first 200 entries are shown; {errors} rows have errors in total. Any number longer than 8 digits is hidden to keep card numbers out of error records.
card.invalid.title: {errors} rows have content errors; this version can't be activated
card.lookup.hint: Enter 6–8 digits; lookups use the BIN only, never a full card number
card.lookup.title: BIN Lookup
card.page.intro: Identifies card brand, funding type, issuer country and other attributes by card BIN. A new version is activated manually after it is imported and validated; each transaction freezes the card attributes when its payment instrument is created, so a rollback doesn't change existing transactions.
card.summary.importedByInvalid: Imported by {createdBy} at {time} · validation failed on {errors} rows
card.summary.noneActive: No version has been activated yet; all cards are unrecognized.
card.upload.connectionFailed: The upload connection failed. Check your network and try again.
card.version.noneActivated: No version has been activated yet
card.versions.empty: No version has been imported yet
card.versions.footnote: All historical versions are kept (deletion isn't available in this release).
card.versions.selectHint: Select a version on the left to see its details.
card.versions.title: Versions
